description: This file defines a Java class AdminAccessDeniedHandler that implements Spring Security's AccessDeniedHandler interface to handle access denied situations by redirecting to a specified URL.

classes.name: AdminAccessDeniedHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages access denied responses by redirecting users to a specific URL.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the access denied event by redirecting to the URL provided by getAccessDeniedUrl().

methods.name: getAccessDeniedUrl
methods.description: Returns the configured URL to redirect to when access is denied.

methods.name: setAccessDeniedUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL to redirect to when access is denied.
